dialogues.jp: やっと解放された……。
dialogues.en: Freedom, finally...
dialogues.text: Freedom, finally...

dialogues.jp: あの人は、人使いが荒すぎる……。
dialogues.en: That woman really knows how to make use of people...
dialogues.text: That woman really knows how to make use of people...

dialogues.jp:
春の日差しも心地よいし、このまま芝生に寝こ
ろんで、うたた寝したいところだけど……。
dialogues.en:
On a beautiful spring day like this, I should be relaxing or
napping on the lawn...
dialogues.text:
On a beautiful spring day like this, I should be relaxing or
napping on the lawn...

dialogues.jp: 今はとてもじゃないが、そんな気分になれない。
dialogues.en:
Although to be honest, the thought of that never came to my
mind.
dialogues.text:
Although to be honest, the thought of that never came to my
mind.

dialogues.jp: 朝の夢が気になって、頭から離れないのだ。
dialogues.en:
The only thing I could think about was the dream I had this
morning.
dialogues.text:
The only thing I could think about was the dream I had this
morning.

dialogues.jp: 環の幼い頃のこと、予知能力のこと……。
dialogues.en: About Tamaki's childhood, and her clairvoyance...
dialogues.text: About Tamaki's childhood, and her clairvoyance...

dialogues.jp: どうしても確かめたい……。
dialogues.en: How can I confirm it...
dialogues.text: How can I confirm it...

dialogues.jp: もちろん、好奇心がないといえば、ウソになる。
dialogues.en: I couldn't say that I wasn't curious about it.
dialogues.text: I couldn't say that I wasn't curious about it.

dialogues.jp: でも、少しでも環の力になれたら……と思う。
dialogues.en:
But if possible, I wanted to give her a little of my
strength too.
dialogues.text:
But if possible, I wanted to give her a little of my
strength too.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとでもいいから話を聞いて、環のために
なにかしてやりたい。
dialogues.en:
If I could just talk with her about it, I could maybe help
her out.
dialogues.text:
If I could just talk with her about it, I could maybe help
her out.

dialogues.jp: で……実際、どうするかだけど。
dialogues.en: ...But, that may not be so easy.
dialogues.text: ...But, that may not be so easy.

dialogues.jp: 朝は美春の邪魔が入ったからな。
dialogues.en: Miharu interrupted us earlier in the morning.
dialogues.text: Miharu interrupted us earlier in the morning.

dialogues.jp:
あれから、姿を見かけないけど、とりあえずは
彼女を捜すことから始めるか。
dialogues.en:
I hadn't seen her at all afterwards... guess I have to start
searching for her.
dialogues.text:
I hadn't seen her at all afterwards... guess I have to start
searching for her.

dialogues.jp:
こういう時は、やはり杉並だな。何だかんだ言っ
ても、奴の情報網は確かだ。
dialogues.en:
For cases like this, I should go to Suginami... despite his
"quirks", his network is second to none.
dialogues.text:
For cases like this, I should go to Suginami... despite his
"quirks", his network is second to none.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、環、見なかった？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, have you seen Tamaki anywhere?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, have you seen Tamaki anywhere?"

dialogues.jp:
こいつは、卒パの準備とやらで｛・・・／忙しい｝らしく、
しばらくは学校にいるらしい。
dialogues.en:
He seemed to be "busy" in school with the graduation party
preparations...
dialogues.text:
He seemed to be "busy" in school with the graduation party
preparations...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「もう｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝に逃げられたのか？　結婚前から離
　婚危機とは、スピーディだな」
dialogues.en:
"Your fiancee's run away? A divorce before marriage,
interesting."
dialogues.text:
"Your fiancee's run away? A divorce before marriage,
interesting."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほっとけ」
dialogues.en: "Cut the crap."
dialogues.text: "Cut the crap."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「慰謝料を請求されてるなら、相談にのるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"If you're looking to start a consolation fund, I'm the man
you want."
dialogues.text:
"If you're looking to start a consolation fund, I'm the man
you want."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「聞く相手を間違えた。じゃあな」
dialogues.en: "...Why did I even bother. See ya."
dialogues.text: "...Why did I even bother. See ya."

dialogues.jp: まったく。こいつは……。
dialogues.en: Bah. This idiot...
dialogues.text: Bah. This idiot...

dialogues.jp:
人の気持ちを察するという日本人なら誰でも持っ
ている能力に欠けている。
dialogues.en: Completely insensitive to other people's feelings.
dialogues.text: Completely insensitive to other people's feelings.

dialogues.jp: そもそも、地球人であるのかも謎だが。
dialogues.en: Is he even human at all?
dialogues.text: Is he even human at all?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、待て。誰も知らんとは言ってなかろう
　に」
dialogues.en: "Now now, no one said I didn't know."
dialogues.text: "Now now, no one said I didn't know."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ、知ってるなら早く言えよ」
dialogues.en: "If you know it, spit it out already."
dialogues.text: "If you know it, spit it out already."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ようやくその気になったとはな。俺もささや
　かながら、祝福させてもらうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"But I'm happy it's come to this. I'd give you two my
blessing."
dialogues.text:
"But I'm happy it's come to this. I'd give you two my
blessing."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何の話だ？」
dialogues.en: "What the?"
dialogues.text: "What the?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「決まってるだろ。胡ノ宮嬢との婚礼だ」
dialogues.en: "I mean, for your marriage ceremony, of course."
dialogues.text: "I mean, for your marriage ceremony, of course."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「婚礼って、おい！」
dialogues.en: "Marriage cermony... hey!"
dialogues.text: "Marriage cermony... hey!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「場所はどこにするんだ？　やはり神社か？
　それとも意外に教会か？」
dialogues.en:
"Where will it be? The shrine? Or perhaps a more scenic
location?"
dialogues.text:
"Where will it be? The shrine? Or perhaps a more scenic
location?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「知らないなら、もう行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "...Since you don't know, I'd just go."
dialogues.text: "...Since you don't know, I'd just go."

dialogues.jp: 今日は、杉並のボケさえもかわす余裕が無い。
dialogues.en: I have no time today for Suginami's idiot act.
dialogues.text: I have no time today for Suginami's idiot act.

dialogues.jp:
環のことで、自分がこんなにもナーバスになっ
ているのが、ちょっと意外だった。
dialogues.en:
I wasn't expecting myself to be this nervous about Tamaki
either.
dialogues.text:
I wasn't expecting myself to be this nervous about Tamaki
either.

dialogues.jp:
情報をあきらめ、俺が杉並に背中を向けようと
すると、
dialogues.en:
Giving up on the idiot, I turned around and started walking
away, when,
dialogues.text:
Giving up on the idiot, I turned around and started walking
away, when,

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「中庭で、さっきみたぞ」
dialogues.en: "I saw her just now, in the courtyard."
dialogues.text: "I saw her just now, in the courtyard."

dialogues.jp: と言った。
dialogues.en: He said to my back.
dialogues.text: He said to my back.

dialogues.jp: だから。
dialogues.en: For God's sake.
dialogues.text: For God's sake.

dialogues.jp: 早く言えって。
dialogues.en: You could've just said that at the start.
dialogues.text: You could've just said that at the start.

dialogues.jp: そんなに俺と絡みたかったのかよ。
dialogues.en: I certainly didn't want to spend that much time with him.
dialogues.text: I certainly didn't want to spend that much time with him.

dialogues.jp: 全身から力が抜けていくのがわかった。
dialogues.en: He tires me out completely.
dialogues.text: He tires me out completely.

dialogues.jp:
さて……杉並の情報が正しければ、ここらへん
にいるはずなんだが……。
dialogues.en:
Let's see... if Suginami's information was right, she should
be somewhere around here...
dialogues.text:
Let's see... if Suginami's information was right, she should
be somewhere around here...

dialogues.jp: お、いたいた！
dialogues.en: Ah, there she is!
dialogues.text: Ah, there she is!

dialogues.jp:
環は中庭のベンチに座って、一人で弁当を食べ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was sitting on a bench in the courtyard, eating her
lunch.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was sitting on a bench in the courtyard, eating her
lunch.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、環が誰かとお弁当を食べているのっ
て、見たことが無い。
dialogues.en: I've never seen her eating lunch with others.
dialogues.text: I've never seen her eating lunch with others.

dialogues.jp:
クラスメートと話はしても、一人で居ることの
方が多いようだ。
dialogues.en:
From what I heard from her classmates, she usually eats by
herself too.
dialogues.text:
From what I heard from her classmates, she usually eats by
herself too.

dialogues.jp:
今まではあまり気にしなかったが、それは、環
が人の未来が見えることで距離を置いていると
いうことなのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Maybe it's because she wants to keep her distance from
people who'd request her to see their future...
dialogues.text:
Maybe it's because she wants to keep her distance from
people who'd request her to see their future...

dialogues.jp:
今はどうしても、環の行動を今朝の夢と当ては
めて考えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I've seen her actions in a whole new light, after this
morning's dream.
dialogues.text:
I've seen her actions in a whole new light, after this
morning's dream.

dialogues.jp:
実際に環は、過去のことはそれほど意識してな
いのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: She might not even remember those days in the past, though.
dialogues.text: She might not even remember those days in the past, though.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、知ってしまった以上は、何か力になり
たいと思う。
dialogues.en: But whether she knows or not, I wanted to help her somehow.
dialogues.text: But whether she knows or not, I wanted to help her somehow.

dialogues.jp: 例え、話を聞くことしかできなかったとしても。
dialogues.en: Better than not talking with her about it at all.
dialogues.text: Better than not talking with her about it at all.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、さっき自販機で買った二人分のジュース
を持って、環に近づいた。
dialogues.en:
With two packets of juice I bought earlier in hand, I
approached Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
With two packets of juice I bought earlier in hand, I
approached Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 「よお」
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.jp: 努めて普通に声をかける。
dialogues.en: I tried my best to sound normal.
dialogues.text: I tried my best to sound normal.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ここ、いいか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you mind if I sit here?"
dialogues.text: "Do you mind if I sit here?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? A, ah, no!"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? A, ah, no!"

dialogues.jp:
環はちょこっと腰をずらして、自分の横を空け
てくれた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki, a little flustered, quickly shifted to the side of
the bench.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki, a little flustered, quickly shifted to the side of
the bench.

dialogues.jp: 「さんきゅ」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の横に腰掛ける。
dialogues.en: I sat down next to her.
dialogues.text: I sat down next to her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら？　朝倉様、お食事は？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Asakura-sama, where is your lunch?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Asakura-sama, where is your lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いや、今日はいらないや。たまにはダイエッ
　トもしないとな」
dialogues.en: "I don't have one today. I'm on a bit of a diet."
dialogues.text: "I don't have one today. I'm on a bit of a diet."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　全然太ってないのに？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? But you're not fat at all..."
dialogues.text: "Ehh? But you're not fat at all..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いや……はは。冗談だよ。ちょっと今、小遣
　いがピンチでさ」
dialogues.en:
"Aha... I was kidding. I'm just having slight... financial
problems right now."
dialogues.text:
"Aha... I was kidding. I'm just having slight... financial
problems right now."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかったら、私のお弁当、食べますか？」
dialogues.en: "Would you like to try some of my lunch, perhaps?"
dialogues.text: "Would you like to try some of my lunch, perhaps?"

dialogues.jp: 環は箸をとめて、弁当箱を俺に軽く差し出す。
dialogues.en: Tamaki offered me the pair of chopsticks she was using.
dialogues.text: Tamaki offered me the pair of chopsticks she was using.

dialogues.jp:
そんなに気を遣うこと無いのに、と言ってやり
たくなる。
dialogues.en:
She seemed so caring, that I almost wanted to take her up on
her offer.
dialogues.text:
She seemed so caring, that I almost wanted to take her up on
her offer.

dialogues.jp: それとも、別の意味での優しさなのだろうか？
dialogues.en: She might even have another reason to be so nice..
dialogues.text: She might even have another reason to be so nice..

dialogues.jp: 「いや、いい。今度の楽しみにとっておくよ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, no thanks. Definitely next time, though."
dialogues.text: "Ah, no thanks. Definitely next time, though."

dialogues.jp: 「それより、これ」
dialogues.en: "This though, is for you."
dialogues.text: "This though, is for you."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、さっき買っておいたオレンジジュースを
一本手渡す。
dialogues.en: I passed her one of the cans of orange juice I had bought.
dialogues.text: I passed her one of the cans of orange juice I had bought.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わあ、ありがとうございます。でも、いいん
　ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah! But... are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Ah! But... are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「今回のテスト、結構出来が良かったんだ。そ
　の祝いだと思って、グイッとやってくれ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm in a good mood thanks to the tests, so I bought these
as celebration."
dialogues.text:
"I'm in a good mood thanks to the tests, so I bought these
as celebration."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ウフフ……じゃあ、いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe... thank you."
dialogues.text: "Ehehe... thank you."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑って、ジュースに口をつけた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki giggled as she brought the can to her mouth.
dialogues.text: Tamaki giggled as she brought the can to her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
それを見て、俺もジュースを飲む。なんか、こ
ういう雰囲気も悪くない。
dialogues.en: I followed suit. Somehow, this atmosphere feels nice.
dialogues.text: I followed suit. Somehow, this atmosphere feels nice.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、環には敵わなかったな。転校してきた
　ばかりなのに大したものだよ」
dialogues.en:
"I can't match up to you though, Tamaki. Even despite
transferring schools so much."
dialogues.text:
"I can't match up to you though, Tamaki. Even despite
transferring schools so much."

dialogues.jp: 「案外、テストの問題わかってたりしてな？」
dialogues.en: "You know what questions would've come up, right?"
dialogues.text: "You know what questions would've come up, right?"

dialogues.jp: ちょっとだけ、鎌をかけてみる。
dialogues.en: I went for the roundabout kill.
dialogues.text: I went for the roundabout kill.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、ヤマカンじゃなくて、本当に問題がわ
　かってさ。あの、予知能力というか……」
dialogues.en:
"Not guessing, I mean. After all, you have that
clairvoyance..."
dialogues.text:
"Not guessing, I mean. After all, you have that
clairvoyance..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の言葉に反応したリトマス紙のように、環の
顔からどんどん血の気が引いていく。
dialogues.en:
Her reaction to my words was the litmus test, and sure
enough, blood started to rush to her face.
dialogues.text:
Her reaction to my words was the litmus test, and sure
enough, blood started to rush to her face.

dialogues.jp:
環は、予知能力がある、ということを、この学
校の人間には隠していたいのだろう。
dialogues.en:
She'd want to hide her clairvoyance to the people of this
school, after all.
dialogues.text:
She'd want to hide her clairvoyance to the people of this
school, after all.

dialogues.jp:
だから、食堂での突拍子も無いと思われている、
事件が起こったのである。
dialogues.en: That's why those crazy things happened at the cafeteria.
dialogues.text: That's why those crazy things happened at the cafeteria.

dialogues.jp: 本当の理由は言わずに、危険だけを回避する。
dialogues.en:
The real reason behind those... so that she could've
prevented dangerous incidents from happening.
dialogues.text:
The real reason behind those... so that she could've
prevented dangerous incidents from happening.

dialogues.jp:
あれがもし、環が未来を見れることが知られて
いたら、きっと別の意味で校内の噂となったこ
とだろう。
dialogues.en:
If it was known that she could see the future... there'd
definitely be other types of rumours spreading.
dialogues.text:
If it was known that she could see the future... there'd
definitely be other types of rumours spreading.

dialogues.jp:
それは、環にとっては堪えられないことに違い
ない。
dialogues.en: Tamaki wouldn't be able to survive in that environment.
dialogues.text: Tamaki wouldn't be able to survive in that environment.

dialogues.jp:
許嫁の俺にも、能力については知られたくない
のだろう。
dialogues.en: But I'm her fiance... I want to know about these things.
dialogues.text: But I'm her fiance... I want to know about these things.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どういうことですか？」
dialogues.en: "W, what do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "W, what do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 蒼ざめながらも、環は、とぼけようとしている。
dialogues.en:
She tried to deny it, despite her face giving it away
entirely.
dialogues.text:
She tried to deny it, despite her face giving it away
entirely.

dialogues.jp: 「俺にまで隠すなよ」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to hide it from me."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to hide it from me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「環は、先のことがわかるんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "You remember about last time, right?"
dialogues.text: "You remember about last time, right?"

dialogues.jp: 環は黙ったまま、じっと考えている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki quietly stared at me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki quietly stared at me.

dialogues.jp: きっと、言うべきかどうか迷っているのだろう。
dialogues.en: She looked to be at a loss for words.
dialogues.text: She looked to be at a loss for words.

dialogues.jp: 「わかるんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様に、ウソはつけないですよね……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama really doesn't tell lies..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama really doesn't tell lies..."

dialogues.jp: 力の無い声で、環はつぶやく。
dialogues.en: Tamaki murmured in a defeated voice.
dialogues.text: Tamaki murmured in a defeated voice.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり……」
dialogues.en: "As I thought..."
dialogues.text: "As I thought..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「でも……テストや、勝負とか、そういった未
　来は見えないんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"But... for tests, competitions and such, I cannot see the
future for them."
dialogues.text:
"But... for tests, competitions and such, I cannot see the
future for them."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "...I see."
dialogues.text: "...I see."

dialogues.jp:
見えたところで、多分、環は悪用しないのだろ
う。それは言われなくてもわかる。
dialogues.en:
Even if she could, she's not the type to use it for selfish
purposes anyway.
dialogues.text:
Even if she could, she's not the type to use it for selfish
purposes anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……私は、『人の未来』が見えるんです。こ
　の人がいつ、どこで、どうなるか……」
dialogues.en:
"...What I can see are people's futures. What someone will
be doing, when, and where..."
dialogues.text:
"...What I can see are people's futures. What someone will
be doing, when, and where..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「良い未来ばかりならいいんですけど、もちろ
　ん、そんなことはありませんし」
dialogues.en:
"It would be nice if all the futures of people were good,
but of course, that isn't always the case."
dialogues.text:
"It would be nice if all the futures of people were good,
but of course, that isn't always the case."

dialogues.jp:
良い未来は歓迎されるが、逆の場合は、かえっ
て恨みを買ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
If it's a good future, they'd welcome it, but if it's not,
it'd be resented.
dialogues.text:
If it's a good future, they'd welcome it, but if it's not,
it'd be resented.

dialogues.jp:
自分が良かれと思って教えてあげても、相手に
は必ずいいとは限らない。
dialogues.en:
And even what one might think is a good future, may not
neccessarily be seen as so by another.
dialogues.text:
And even what one might think is a good future, may not
neccessarily be seen as so by another.

dialogues.jp:
未来について発言することによって、その人の
将来の責任を一部、背負ってしまう……。
dialogues.en:
And once that future is uttered, it becomes the viewer's
responsibility...
dialogues.text:
And once that future is uttered, it becomes the viewer's
responsibility...

dialogues.jp: 環はこの小さな肩に、それを背負ってきたんだ。
dialogues.en: She's shouldering that burden on her thin shoulders.
dialogues.text: She's shouldering that burden on her thin shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、気味悪いですよね。人の未来を覗
　き見できるなんて……」
dialogues.en:
"It's not a very good feeling either, to be peeping in on
others' futures like that..."
dialogues.text:
"It's not a very good feeling either, to be peeping in on
others' futures like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そういう力があるのって、普通じゃないから」
dialogues.en: "It's not normal at all to have that kind of power."
dialogues.text: "It's not normal at all to have that kind of power."

dialogues.jp: 環の瞳が、あまりにも寂しそうで。
dialogues.en: Her eyes looked sad and lonely.
dialogues.text: Her eyes looked sad and lonely.

dialogues.jp:
隣にいる女の子の、肩を抱いてあげられたら、
どんなに楽なんだろう。
dialogues.en:
My hand started to lift up, wanting to pat her on the
shoulder.
dialogues.text:
My hand started to lift up, wanting to pat her on the
shoulder.

dialogues.jp: でも、俺の中でブレーキがかかる。
dialogues.en: But something in me put on the brakes.
dialogues.text: But something in me put on the brakes.

dialogues.jp:
肩を抱くのはいいが、そこに背負っているもの
を俺は分かち合えるのか……？
dialogues.en:
Patting her on the shoulder is fine and all, but to share
the burden she has...?
dialogues.text:
Patting her on the shoulder is fine and all, but to share
the burden she has...?

dialogues.jp: まだ、俺には、そんな自信はない。
dialogues.en: I don't have that much confidence in myself.
dialogues.text: I don't have that much confidence in myself.

dialogues.jp:
だから、俺は言葉でしか彼女を慰めることがで
きない。
dialogues.en: That would've been too forward, to console her.
dialogues.text: That would've been too forward, to console her.

dialogues.jp: 精一杯、俺なりの言葉で。
dialogues.en: I could only do my best...
dialogues.text: I could only do my best...

dialogues.jp: 「俺さ、そういうのよく分からないんだ」
dialogues.en: "I don't know about that."
dialogues.text: "I don't know about that."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いや、不思議な力のこと。予知能力って、例
　えが悪いけど、運動神経がいいとか、勉強が
　できるとかと」
dialogues.en:
"About it being strange. Clairvoyance on your level is
unsettling, but lots of stuff can be predicted."
dialogues.text:
"About it being strange. Clairvoyance on your level is
unsettling, but lots of stuff can be predicted."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あまり変わらないような気がするんだよね」
dialogues.en:
"Things tend to repeat themselves over and over again, after
all."
dialogues.text:
"Things tend to repeat themselves over and over again, after
all."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「運動できて、気味が悪いって言われるヤツ、
　いないだろ？　だから、予知能力も一緒なん
　じゃないのかな？」
dialogues.en:
"And others would call people who're good at predicting as
smart, no? Isn't that the same as clairvoyance?"
dialogues.text:
"And others would call people who're good at predicting as
smart, no? Isn't that the same as clairvoyance?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ただちょっと、人より未来が見えるだけで、
　俺にとっては、友達になるのに大した問題じ
　ゃないよ」
dialogues.en:
"And I have no problems with being friends with a person who
can see people's futures."
dialogues.text:
"And I have no problems with being friends with a person who
can see people's futures."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp:
俺には、他人の夢を見る能力があっても、予知
能力はない。
dialogues.en:
My ability to see other people's dreams isn't quite the same
as hers.
dialogues.text:
My ability to see other people's dreams isn't quite the same
as hers.

dialogues.jp:
だから、本当の環の苦しみを、わかってあげら
れてないのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: But in a way, I can relate to how she's feeling now.
dialogues.text: But in a way, I can relate to how she's feeling now.

dialogues.jp: それでも、環を励ましてあげたい。
dialogues.en: What I wanted to do was encourage her.
dialogues.text: What I wanted to do was encourage her.

dialogues.jp: 環に、元気になって欲しい。
dialogues.en: I want her to be happy.
dialogues.text: I want her to be happy.

dialogues.jp: 自分のことを、責めないで欲しい。
dialogues.en: To not beat herself up over her powers.
dialogues.text: To not beat herself up over her powers.

dialogues.jp: そんなことしか、俺にはできないけど。
dialogues.en: Even though I find it hard to do that myself.
dialogues.text: Even though I find it hard to do that myself.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そういう風に言ってもらえると、すごく嬉し
　いです」
dialogues.en: "I am really glad that you see it so positively."
dialogues.text: "I am really glad that you see it so positively."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の瞳を見つめて言う。
dialogues.en: She looked deep into my eyes as she spoke.
dialogues.text: She looked deep into my eyes as she spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様と一緒にいると、自然でいられる気が
　します」
dialogues.en:
"I find myself a lot more natural when I am with you as
well."
dialogues.text:
"I find myself a lot more natural when I am with you as
well."

dialogues.jp:
ストレートの環の言葉に、俺はストレートには
返せない。
dialogues.en: She was so honest to me, I couldn't really answer back.
dialogues.text: She was so honest to me, I couldn't really answer back.

dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうか？」
dialogues.en: "R, really?"
dialogues.text: "R, really?"

dialogues.jp:
そんなこと、面と向かって言われたら照れるだ
ろうが。
dialogues.en:
Her saying something like that so honestly... how
embarassing.
dialogues.text:
Her saying something like that so honestly... how
embarassing.

dialogues.jp: 柄にも無く、赤面してしまった。
dialogues.en: She was making me blush beet red.
dialogues.text: She was making me blush beet red.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだ！」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah!"
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、それを誤魔化すように思いついた振りを
する。
dialogues.en: I changed the subject to hide my embarassment.
dialogues.text: I changed the subject to hide my embarassment.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あのさ、素朴な疑問なんだけど……。もちろ
　ん、俺の未来も見えたりするわけ？」
dialogues.en:
"It's a bit of a stupid question, but... you can see my
future too, right?"
dialogues.text:
"It's a bit of a stupid question, but... you can see my
future too, right?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は冗談めかして聞いてみる。
dialogues.en: I jokingly asked her.
dialogues.text: I jokingly asked her.

dialogues.jp: まあ、人間誰しもが気になるところだ。
dialogues.en: Well, it's something everyone would want to know.
dialogues.text: Well, it's something everyone would want to know.

dialogues.jp: 『自分の未来はどうなるのか』
dialogues.en: "What does my future look like?"
dialogues.text: "What does my future look like?"

dialogues.jp: 明るいのか、暗いのか、厳しいのか、楽なのか。
dialogues.en: Bright, gloomy, lonely, exciting?
dialogues.text: Bright, gloomy, lonely, exciting?

dialogues.jp: 環が、言葉に詰まっている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was taken aback by my question.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was taken aback by my question.

dialogues.jp: しまった……。
dialogues.en: D'oh...
dialogues.text: D'oh...

dialogues.jp:
これは、聞いちゃいけないことだったのかもし
れない。
dialogues.en: Maybe this was something I shouldn't have brought up.
dialogues.text: Maybe this was something I shouldn't have brought up.

dialogues.jp:
環は俺のことも、『未来が見えるから自分に近
づいた人』と、思ったかも……。
dialogues.en:
She might start thinking of me as someone who got close to
her just for a peek at the future...
dialogues.text:
She might start thinking of me as someone who got close to
her just for a peek at the future...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……はい。わかりますよ」
dialogues.en: "...Yes, I can."
dialogues.text: "...Yes, I can."

dialogues.jp: 環の表情は、曇っている。
dialogues.en: Her expression was cloudy.
dialogues.text: Her expression was cloudy.

dialogues.jp: 明らかに、俺に対して不満に思っている証拠だ。
dialogues.en: No doubt she was dissatisfied with me...
dialogues.text: No doubt she was dissatisfied with me...

dialogues.jp: き、聞かなきゃよかった……。
dialogues.en: I, if only I could erase that thought from her head...
dialogues.text: I, if only I could erase that thought from her head...

dialogues.jp: 後悔先に立たず、とは正にこのこと……。
dialogues.en: This is a clear case of speaking without thinking.
dialogues.text: This is a clear case of speaking without thinking.

dialogues.jp: 昔の人はよく言ったものだ。
dialogues.en: Something I'd have done well to follow since I was young.
dialogues.text: Something I'd have done well to follow since I was young.

dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm."

dialogues.jp: とても今更だが、興味のない返事をする。
dialogues.en:
Even though it's a bit late, I'd just show that I have no
interest.
dialogues.text:
Even though it's a bit late, I'd just show that I have no
interest.

dialogues.jp:
今の環の表情で、自分の中の未来に対する興味
が消えてしまったのは本当だ。
dialogues.en:
Looking at her reaction killed any of my interest in seeing
my future, anyway.
dialogues.text:
Looking at her reaction killed any of my interest in seeing
my future, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「教えましょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to know about it?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to know about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いい。興味ないから」
dialogues.en: "Nah, it's okay. I don't really care about it."
dialogues.text: "Nah, it's okay. I don't really care about it."

dialogues.jp: もちろん、聞くのが怖いのもある。
dialogues.en: Of course, I'd also be kinda scared to hear it.
dialogues.text: Of course, I'd also be kinda scared to hear it.

dialogues.jp:
でも、それよりも、聞いてしまったら、環と対
等じゃいられなくなるような気がする。
dialogues.en: Besides, if I heard about it, we wouldn't be equals anymore.
dialogues.text: Besides, if I heard about it, we wouldn't be equals anymore.

dialogues.jp:
環のことを『自分の未来を知っている人』とし
て、意識してしまうかもしれない。
dialogues.en: She doesn't seem to have been able to see her own future.
dialogues.text: She doesn't seem to have been able to see her own future.

dialogues.jp:
そうしたら、また、自分の未来が気になって、
教えてもらいたいと思ってしまうかもしれない。
dialogues.en: And without knowing hers, yet telling me about mine...
dialogues.text: And without knowing hers, yet telling me about mine...

dialogues.jp: それは、対等ではない。
dialogues.en: That isn't being equal at all.
dialogues.text: That isn't being equal at all.

dialogues.jp: 環は、ジュースを喉を鳴らして、一口飲んだ。
dialogues.en: Tamaki took a large gulp of her juice.
dialogues.text: Tamaki took a large gulp of her juice.

dialogues.jp: そして深いため息をつくと、急に俺の顔を見る。
dialogues.en: She then sighed, and started staring at me.
dialogues.text: She then sighed, and started staring at me.

dialogues.jp: やっぱ、さっき聞いたのを怒ってるのか？
dialogues.en: Is she still angry about what I said earlier?
dialogues.text: Is she still angry about what I said earlier?

dialogues.jp:
『皆と変わらない』とか言っておきながら、自
分も未来を尋ねるなんて……。
dialogues.en:
I'd said that she's no different from everyone else to me,
yet I still asked about my future...
dialogues.text:
I'd said that she's no different from everyone else to me,
yet I still asked about my future...

dialogues.jp: 環は、ジュースの空き缶を指で弾いている。
dialogues.en:
She then started to flicking her finger against the empty
can.
dialogues.text:
She then started to flicking her finger against the empty
can.

dialogues.jp: 軽い金属音が鳴る。
dialogues.en: The soft, metallic noise echoed through the silence.
dialogues.text: The soft, metallic noise echoed through the silence.

dialogues.jp: 怒ってる……みたいだな。
dialogues.en: ...She definitely seems mad.
dialogues.text: ...She definitely seems mad.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 何か責められるのだろうか？
dialogues.en: How badly will I get owned, I wonder?
dialogues.text: How badly will I get owned, I wonder?

dialogues.jp:
しかし、環の目は、怒るというよりは何か憂い
を抱えているように見える。
dialogues.en:
Although... rather than being angry, her eyes showed
sadness.
dialogues.text:
Although... rather than being angry, her eyes showed
sadness.

dialogues.jp: 環の瞳の中に、俺の顔がはっきり映る。
dialogues.en: She stared deeply into my eyes, and she spoke.
dialogues.text: She stared deeply into my eyes, and she spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp: 環はジュースの缶を、自分の隣に置く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki slowly lowered her can between us.
dialogues.text: Tamaki slowly lowered her can between us.

dialogues.jp:
環は一瞬下を向き、手を口元に持っていって、
考える仕草をする。
dialogues.en:
Her hand then went to her chin, as she thought to herself
fervently.
dialogues.text:
Her hand then went to her chin, as she thought to herself
fervently.

dialogues.jp: そしてまた顔を上げ、俺の瞳を見つめる。
dialogues.en:
Then, once again raising her head, she looked straight at
me.
dialogues.text:
Then, once again raising her head, she looked straight at
me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「友達でいいから、私とずっと一緒にいて下さ
　い！」
dialogues.en:
"Even if it's just as friends, please let me be with you
forever!"
dialogues.text:
"Even if it's just as friends, please let me be with you
forever!"

dialogues.jp: と、真剣な表情で言う。
dialogues.en: She implored of me, with an entirely serious face.
dialogues.text: She implored of me, with an entirely serious face.

dialogues.jp:
言う、というよりは、訴えるに近いかも知れな
い。
dialogues.en: It was as close to a heartfelt request as anyone could get.
dialogues.text: It was as close to a heartfelt request as anyone could get.

dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、少し拍子抜けしてしまった。
dialogues.en: I was completely off, apparently.
dialogues.text: I was completely off, apparently.

dialogues.jp:
てっきり、環はさっきの俺の質問に怒っている
のだとばかり思っていたのに。
dialogues.en: I was so sure that she was angry at me for my question too.
dialogues.text: I was so sure that she was angry at me for my question too.

dialogues.jp: 女の子って、やっぱり謎の生き物だ。
dialogues.en: Women are really strange.
dialogues.text: Women are really strange.

dialogues.jp: そんなの、約束しなくったって一緒にいるさ。
dialogues.en: And to ask for such a promise as well...
dialogues.text: And to ask for such a promise as well...

dialogues.jp: 「あたりまえだろ。俺と環は友達じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "You don't need me to promise that. We're friends, no?"
dialogues.text: "You don't need me to promise that. We're friends, no?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は少し安心して、環の方に顔を向ける。
dialogues.en: Relieved, I turned to her and nodded.
dialogues.text: Relieved, I turned to her and nodded.

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の倍、安心しているようで、
dialogues.en:
Tamaki, for her part, seemed several times more relieved
than I was.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki, for her part, seemed several times more relieved
than I was.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "Thank goodness..."
dialogues.text: "Thank goodness..."

dialogues.jp: と、本当に嬉しそうだ。
dialogues.en: She really seems glad.
dialogues.text: She really seems glad.

dialogues.jp:
そんな環を見ているだけで、思わず俺も嬉しく
なってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Her cheerfulness was infectious; I soon had a smile on my
face too.
dialogues.text:
Her cheerfulness was infectious; I soon had a smile on my
face too.

dialogues.jp: それだけのことなのに。
dialogues.en: She makes people that way...
dialogues.text: She makes people that way...

dialogues.jp: しかし……、なぜ、友達なんて言葉を使うんだ。
dialogues.en: But... why did she use the word "friends" so specifically?
dialogues.text: But... why did she use the word "friends" so specifically?

dialogues.jp: 友達は約束してなるもんじゃない。
dialogues.en: I've never promised to be friends with anyone.
dialogues.text: I've never promised to be friends with anyone.

dialogues.jp: 幼い頃も、環にそう言っていた。
dialogues.en: That's what Tamaki said when she was young.
dialogues.text: That's what Tamaki said when she was young.

dialogues.jp:
そして、ここまで仲良くなっている上で、わざ
わざあんなことを言うなんて。
dialogues.en:
But now, with how well she's grown and how mature she is,
saying things like that...
dialogues.text:
But now, with how well she's grown and how mature she is,
saying things like that...

dialogues.jp:
子どもの頃のこととはいえ、『結婚の約束』ま
でした仲だというのに。
dialogues.en: And still having that marriage promise, on top of that.
dialogues.text: And still having that marriage promise, on top of that.

dialogues.jp:
聞かなければ。環の過去。許嫁である理由。深
い絆のこと。
dialogues.en:
I have to tell her... about the past, the reason why I'm her
fiance, and our deep bond.
dialogues.text:
I have to tell her... about the past, the reason why I'm her
fiance, and our deep bond.

dialogues.jp:
俺が思い出したことを伝えれば、少しはなにか
思い出すかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
If I tell her what I remember, maybe she'd start remembering
too.
dialogues.text:
If I tell her what I remember, maybe she'd start remembering
too.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「小さいときの事だけど……」
dialogues.en: "When you were a kid..."
dialogues.text: "When you were a kid..."

dialogues.jp: そこで、
dialogues.en: Right then,
dialogues.text: Right then,

dialogues.jp: キ〜ンコ〜ン、カ〜ンコ〜ン
dialogues.en: --*ding dong, ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*ding dong, ding dong*

dialogues.jp: いっつも。
dialogues.en: ...Always.
dialogues.text: ...Always.

dialogues.jp: 核心に触れようとすると、邪魔が入るんだよな。
dialogues.en:
Just when I'm about to breach the important subject,
something interferes.
dialogues.text:
Just when I'm about to breach the important subject,
something interferes.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「大変。つい居心地がよくて、長居してしまい
　ましたね」
dialogues.en: "Oh my... we've been chatting here for too long."
dialogues.text: "Oh my... we've been chatting here for too long."

dialogues.jp:
環の顔は、先ほどの表情とはうって変わって、
とても晴れ晴れとしている。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's expression quickly changed to a bright, cheerful
one.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's expression quickly changed to a bright, cheerful
one.

dialogues.jp: 環はベンチから立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: She quickly stood up from the bench.
dialogues.text: She quickly stood up from the bench.

dialogues.jp: 「しゃーねー。行くか」
dialogues.en: "I'd get moving too. See you later."
dialogues.text: "I'd get moving too. See you later."

dialogues.jp:
不本意ながら、俺も立ち上がる。午後の手伝い
に遅れたら、卒業が取り消しになるかもしれん。
dialogues.en:
I reluctantly stood up. If I'm late for graduation party
preparations, who knows what'd happen.
dialogues.text:
I reluctantly stood up. If I'm late for graduation party
preparations, who knows what'd happen.

dialogues.jp: まあ、焦ることも無いか……。
dialogues.en: Oh well, I suppose that matter's something that can wait...
dialogues.text: Oh well, I suppose that matter's something that can wait...

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は、立ち上がり、校舎へと向かった。
dialogues.en: We started walking towards the school building, together.
dialogues.text: We started walking towards the school building, together.

dialogues.jp: ◆予知能力の話◆
dialogues.en: ◆Clairvoyant Conversation?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Clairvoyant Conversation?◆

dialogues.jp:
環を探しに中庭に来た俺は、環に予知能力につ
いて尋ねる。
dialogues.en:
I went to the courtyard in search of Tamaki, and asked about
her clairvoyance.
dialogues.text:
I went to the courtyard in search of Tamaki, and asked about
her clairvoyance.

dialogues.jp: 環は能力を認め、俺の言葉に喜ぶ。
dialogues.en: She was happy at me accepting her powers easily.
dialogues.text: She was happy at me accepting her powers easily.

dialogues.jp:
俺が未来について尋ねると暗い表情になり、
『友達でいいからずっと一緒に居てください』
と訴える。
dialogues.en:
Although her expression darkened when I asked about my
future, she insisted on being friends forever.
dialogues.text:
Although her expression darkened when I asked about my
future, she insisted on being friends forever.
